==Purpose of template==

Marking unsupported statements that are probably true as needing citations, sources, or more solid evidence for the claim.

==How to use==

If you see this tag on a page and know the reference, please [[Wotwiki:Be bold|be bold]] and [[Wotwiki:Cite your sources|add it to the page]].

To find all the articles that use this template, please visit [[Special:Whatlinkshere/Template:Verify]], or use [[:Category:Citation needed]].

==Examples==

<pre>The quick{{verify}} brown fox jumped{{verify}} over the lazy dog.{{verify|Was the dog actually lazy?}}</pre>

The quick{{verify}} brown fox jumped{{verify}} over the lazy dog.{{verify|Was the dog actually lazy?}}

{{notes}}
